en.headline: Hong Kong records net loss of 40 kindergartens amid falling births
en.dek: The Education Bureau’s latest profiles show 930 kindergartens operating, a record annual net decrease of 40 as the student population shrinks and first-time mothers grow older.

zh.headline: 本港幼稚園按年淨減40間 創紀錄跌幅
zh.dek: 教育局最新概覽顯示全港約有930間幼稚園運作，按年淨減40間，為歷來最高，學生人口持續萎縮。

en.headline: Hong Kong China International Tattoo Exhibition opens at Soho House
en.dek: More than 60 tattoo artists from Hong Kong and overseas gather at Sheung Wan’s Soho House from Friday to Sunday, with live work, an AI try-on feature and a competition on the final day.

zh.headline: 香港中國國際紋身展於上環Soho House開幕
zh.dek: 逾60位本地及海外紋身師周五至周日雲集上環德輔道西Soho House，有即場創作、AI試紋功能及最後一天比賽。

en.headline: Fire breaks out in Sham Shui Po tenement staircase, no injuries
en.dek: Clutter caught alight in the back staircase of a building on Un Chau Street early Friday; firefighters extinguished the blaze within minutes and no one was evacuated.

zh.headline: 深水埗唐樓後樓梯雜物起火 無人受傷毋須疏散
zh.dek: 周五凌晨元州街一幢唐樓後樓梯雜物起火，消防在數分鐘內撲滅，沒有人受傷或需要疏散。

en.headline: Hong Kong Electronics Fair Autumn edition enters final day at HKCEC
en.dek: The HKTDC-organised fair and concurrent electronicAsia feature more than 3200 exhibitors focusing on AI, robotics and future industries until 5pm today.

zh.headline: 香港秋季電子產品展進入最後一天 會展聚焦AI與機械人
zh.dek: 貿發局主辦的秋電展及同期電子組件展匯聚逾3200家展商，周五下午5時結束，重點展示人工智能、機械人及未來產業。

en.headline: Hong Kong Ballet premieres Dunhuang: In Search of Light this weekend
en.dek: The world premiere runs 16-18 October at the Hong Kong Cultural Centre, fusing classical ballet with Dunhuang imagery and Hermann Hesse's Siddhartha.

zh.headline: 港芭《敦煌：溯光行》本周末世界首演
zh.dek: 作品16至18日於香港文化中心上演，結合古典芭蕾、敦煌意象及赫塞《流浪者之歌》。

en.headline: Major Sports Events Committee awards M Mark to three international tournaments
en.dek: The Link Hong Kong Open, Hong Kong Cricket Sixes and Prudential Hong Kong Tennis Open receive the status for events later this month and next.

zh.headline: 大型體育活動事務委員會授予三項國際賽事M品牌認證
zh.dek: 領展香港高爾夫球公開賽、香港六人板球賽及保誠香港網球公開賽獲認證，分別於本月底及下月初舉行。

en.headline: EMSD finds serious deficiencies in Tai Yip lift works at two estates
en.dek: Forty-eight lifts at Tsui Ping North and Pok Hong Estates were reported complete without fire-door frames; the department is referring the case to police and ordering repairs within a month.

zh.headline: 機電署發現臺日電梯兩屋邨換𨋢工程嚴重缺失
zh.dek: 翠屏北邨及博康邨共48部升降機未裝耐火門框卻報稱完工，署方將事件轉介警方，並限一個月內完成執修。

en.headline: Hospital Authority appeals for liver donor for 13-year-old boy
en.dek: The boy at Queen Mary Hospital is in serious condition with severe liver failure and complications, topping the O+ waiting list as officials prepare to seek mainland assistance.

zh.headline: 醫管局呼籲為13歲男童尋找肝臟捐贈者
zh.dek: 男童現於瑪麗醫院留醫，情況嚴重，肝功能衰竭並有併發症，位列O+血型輪候名單首位，當局正準備向內地尋求協助。

en.headline: Three injured in Kwun Tong Bypass three-vehicle collision
en.dek: A private car struck a Citybus and another car near MegaBox on Thursday evening, briefly trapping a driver and closing the Yau Tong-bound lanes.

zh.headline: 觀塘繞道三車相撞釀三人受傷
zh.dek: 周四晚上近MegaBox一輛私家車撞及城巴及另一私家車，一名司機一度被困，往油塘方向全線封閉。

en.headline: Science Museum opens Future Science Prize exhibition until mid-November
en.dek: The free-with-permanent-ticket show at Tsim Sha Tsui runs from Friday to 18 November and introduces the prize, Hong Kong laureates and interactive displays on past winning fields.

zh.headline: 科學館「2026未來科學大獎展覽」周五起展出至11月中
zh.dek: 尖沙咀科學館地下展覽廳即日起至11月18日開放，常設展門票已包括，介紹大獎、本港歷年得獎者及互動展品。

en.headline: Election Committee receives 29 more nomination forms on day nine
en.dek: Returning officers took in 26 candidate forms and three from designated bodies on Thursday, lifting the cumulative totals to 1,112 and 38 respectively ahead of the October 20 close.

zh.headline: 選委會選舉提名期第九日再接獲29份提名表格
zh.dek: 選舉主任今日接獲26份候選人提名表格及3份指定團體提名表格，累計分別達1112份及38份，提名期將於10月20日結束。

en.headline: Hospital Authority to suspend Lok Ma Chau emergency hospital for upgrades
en.dek: Facility optimisation works starting next Tuesday cover ceiling insulation, flooring repairs, air-conditioning maintenance and a backup water tank, with services paused until the first quarter of 2027.

zh.headline: 醫管局公布河套應急醫院下周二起進行設施優化工程
zh.dek: 工程涵蓋更換天花隔熱物料、加固地面、空調保養及加設備用水箱，期間暫停服務，預計明年第一季完成後恢復。

en.headline: Government proposes bilingual price lists for private medical facilities
en.dek: The Health Bureau plans to submit regulations by year-end requiring fixed prices or ranges and pre-admission budget estimates for hospitals, with measures for private hospitals starting as early as August 2027.

zh.headline: 政府擬規定私營醫療機構提供中英雙語價目表
zh.dek: 醫務衛生局計劃年底向立法會提交規例，要求列出固定價格或價格範圍，私家醫院須提供入院前費用預算，措施最早明年8月起適用於私家醫院。

en.headline: Productivity Council opens Hong Kong's first embodied AI robot training ground
en.dek: The facility under the Hong Kong Productivity Council brings together technology and scene partners to test humanoid and other robots in real industrial, logistics and public-service settings.

zh.headline: 生產力局成立本港首個具身智能及人形機械人訓練場
zh.dek: 香港工業人工智能與機械人研發中心設立「具身智能國際應用訓練場」，匯聚技術及場景夥伴，推動機械人在工業、物流及公共服務等實景測試。

en.headline: Police arrest 22 in Sham Shui Po crackdown on high-interest loan syndicate
en.dek: Sham Shui Po crime officers dismantled a group operating two licensed finance companies in Yau Ma Tei that charged effective annual rates above 300 per cent and used intimidation to collect debts.

zh.headline: 警搗高利貸集團拘捕22人 包括主腦及骨幹成員
zh.dek: 深水埗警區刑事部行動中拘捕22人，揭發兩間油麻地持牌財務公司實際年利率逾300%，並以恐嚇及淋油等手段收數。

en.headline: Government to tender Shek Mun site for about 960 private homes
en.dek: The Development Bureau announced the third-quarter land sale programme, saying the first three quarters already exceed the annual private housing supply target of 12,600 units.

zh.headline: 政府推售石門住宅地 料提供約960個單位
zh.dek: 發展局公布第三季賣地計劃，推出沙田石門住宅用地，首三季供應已超全年私人房屋目標12600個單位。

en.headline: Police arrest two over Tai Po gold necklace theft and recover part of chain
en.dek: Officers detained a 37-year-old man and a 29-year-old woman within 24 hours of the theft at a Chow Sang Sang store on Kwong Fuk Road, retrieving part of the 60-gram chain.

zh.headline: 大埔周生生金鏈盜竊案 警方拘捕兩人並起回部分金鏈
zh.dek: 大埔警區重案組今日拘捕一名37歲男子及一名29歲女子，涉於廣福道周生生金行盜取約值7.9萬元、重約60克的金鏈，並起回部分贓物。

en.headline: Police arrest six over HK$14 million agarwood investment scheme
en.dek: Officers raided a Kwun Tong office and warehouse in an operation codenamed Shadow Net after 21 mostly elderly victims reported losses ranging from HK$30,000 to HK$1.9 million.

zh.headline: 警方搗破沉香樹投資騙局拘捕6人涉款1400萬
zh.dek: 商業罪案調查科展開代號「影網」行動，搜查觀塘辦事處及倉庫，21名受害人多為長者，個別損失由3萬至190萬元。

en.headline: HKU forecasts third-quarter growth of 3.7 per cent, full-year 4.1 per cent
en.dek: The APEC Studies Programme revised the annual figure up by 0.4 points on stronger first-half trade, but expects fourth-quarter growth to slow to 2.8 per cent amid weaker consumer confidence.

zh.headline: 港大料第三季經濟按年增3.7% 全年預測上調至4.1%
zh.dek: 亞太經濟合作研究項目指上半年外貿較預期理想，帶動全年預測上調0.4個百分點，但消費者信心疲弱令第三季放緩，第四季料再降至2.8%。

en.headline: Lingnan University drops external English test for graduation
en.dek: Undergraduates must now pass university English courses instead of achieving a set IELTS score; the change took effect immediately after the Senate approved it earlier this week.

zh.headline: 嶺南大學取消本科生校外英語試畢業要求
zh.dek: 學生只需修畢並及格指定校內英語課程即可畢業，取代過往須達雅思指定分數的規定，有關修訂本周教務會通過後即時生效。

en.headline: Security chief Chris Tang receives scam call impersonating bureau officer
en.dek: Tang challenged the caller to find him on the 10th floor of government headquarters after being told he had violated mainland laws and must report for identity checks.

zh.headline: 保安局局長鄧炳強接獲假冒保安局人員詐騙電話
zh.dek: 對方聲稱他涉嫌觸犯內地法律，要求到政府總部十樓核實身份，鄧炳強反邀對方親自到場找他。

en.headline: CK Asset denies rumour of Li Ka-shing's death as utterly without foundation
en.dek: The company condemned mainland self-media accounts that falsely claimed Ta Kung Pao had reported the 98-year-old tycoon's death, and urged verification before sharing.

zh.headline: 長實否認李嘉誠逝世傳聞 指絕無其事並譴責捏造假新聞
zh.dek: 公司指內地自媒體訛稱大公報報道98歲李嘉誠逝世，實屬捏造，呼籲報道或轉載前務必核實。

en.headline: HKMA launches ART framework for responsible AI in banking
en.dek: The framework focuses on accountability, resilience and trust as banks move from generative to agentic artificial intelligence applications.

zh.headline: 金管局公布ART框架推動銀行業負責任應用人工智能
zh.dek: 框架着重可問責、具韌性及可信賴，應對銀行由生成式轉向代理式人工智能應用。

en.headline: Baidu opens free robotaxi public trials in Tung Chung next week
en.dek: Apollo Go vehicles will run a 5.1-kilometre loop from Yat Tung Estate for two weeks starting 21 October, with ride vouchers distributed through the Islands District Council.

zh.headline: 百度蘿蔔快跑下周三起東涌公眾試乘 為期兩周
zh.dek: 自動車每日下午2至6時行走約5.1公里固定路線，由逸東邨出發折返，乘車券經離島區議會派發，每次最多載兩人。

en.headline: Education Bureau posts 2026/27 kindergarten profiles online
en.dek: The overview lists basic information for about 930 kindergartens and kindergarten-cum-child care centres, including fees, staffing, student numbers and support for non-Chinese-speaking and special-needs children.

zh.headline: 教育局發布2026/27學年幼稚園概覽網上版
zh.dek: 載列全港約930所幼稚園及幼稚園暨幼兒中心基本資料，包括學費、師資、學生人數，以及對非華語及有特殊需要學童的支援。

en.headline: Hong Kong Pride Rainbow Market at Central Market cancelled
en.dek: Organisers said the venue cited an administrative error after confirming the booking and receiving a deposit; this is the second year a planned venue fell through after details were announced.

zh.headline: 香港同志遊行彩虹市集因中環街市場地取消
zh.dek: 籌委會指場地確認及收取訂金後以「行政出錯」重複租場為由未能提供場地，已是連續第二年公布詳情後場地出問題。

en.headline: Space Museum opens 3D dome film Explore the Stars until July 2027
en.dek: The 28-minute show in the Sky Theatre runs from 15 October, with standard tickets at HK$30–40 and concession rates of HK$15–20; English screenings are available on Monday and Thursday evenings.

zh.headline: 太空館天象廳新片《尋星探宇3D》上映至明年7月
zh.dek: 28分鐘立體球幕電影即日起放映，標準票30至40元，優惠票15至20元；周一及周四傍晚有英語場。

en.headline: MTR probes two Lam Tin disruptions within 15 hours
en.dek: The operator apologised after a trackside fire and overheating wires forced service skips and suspensions; the government ordered a report within a month.

zh.headline: 港鐵調查藍田站15小時內兩宗故障 政府要求一個月內交報告
zh.dek: 周二晚軌旁絕緣部件起火及周三早月台電房電線過熱，先後影響繁忙時間服務；運輸及物流局局長要求徹底調查並提交報告。

en.headline: ICAC survey finds 99.2 per cent of respondents had no personal encounter with corruption
en.dek: The 2025 annual survey of about 1,500 people recorded the highest such figure on record and a mean tolerance score of 0.3 out of 10.

zh.headline: 廉署調查顯示99.2%受訪者過去一年未親歷貪污 創紀錄
zh.dek: 2025年周年民調訪問約1500人，貪污容忍度平均僅0.3分，97.9%認為社會廉潔對香港發展重要。

en.headline: Happy Valley vegetable stall reports tabby cat Garlic missing
en.dek: Staff at a produce shop on Tsap Tseung Street told police the four-year-old neutered cat was last seen Wednesday evening; an AirTag ping pointed to Tuen Mun early Thursday.

zh.headline: 跑馬地菜檔花貓「蒜頭」失蹤 飼主報警尋貓
zh.dek: 集祥街菜檔職員今早報案，指約四歲已絕育花貓昨晚仍在店內，今晨不見蹤影；項圈追蹤器凌晨一度顯示屯門位置。

en.headline: September visitor arrivals reach 4.03 million, up 22 per cent
en.dek: The Tourism Board said the Mid-Autumn Festival and festive events helped push first-nine-month arrivals past 40.7 million, a 12 per cent rise.

zh.headline: 9月訪港旅客約403萬人次按年升22% 首九個月逾4070萬
zh.dek: 旅發局指中秋假期及多項節慶活動帶動增長，內地客升近三成，全年累計升12%。

en.headline: Fire at Yau Lai Estate unit in Yau Tong leaves five injured
en.dek: Firefighters extinguished a blaze on the ninth floor of Sau Lai House shortly after 10.50am; one woman in her seventies was taken to hospital while about 100 residents were evacuated.

zh.headline: 油塘油麗邨單位起火 初步5人受傷約百人疏散
zh.dek: 秀麗樓九樓單位上午約10時49分起火，消防約29分鐘後將火救熄；約70歲女住戶送聯合醫院，另有4人輕傷毋須送院。

en.headline: Consumer Council reports nearly 2705 customer service complaints this year
en.dek: The figure up to August approaches last year’s full-year total, with common issues including no follow-up, uncontactable service and slow responses; the Council notes AI tools can help but often need human backup.

zh.headline: 消委會今年接獲近2705宗客戶服務投訴 逼近去年全年數字
zh.dek: 截至8月的數字已接近去年全年總數，常見問題包括無人跟進、聯絡不到及跟進緩慢；消委會指人工智能有助提升效率，但仍需真人支援。

en.headline: HKDI exhibition shows rare Leslie Cheung photos until mid-November
en.dek: The free display at the Hong Kong Design Institute in Tseung Kwan O features previously unpublished archival images from the 1980s and 1990s, a concert microphone stand and student works, with advance online…

zh.headline: 知專設計學院張國榮紀念展展出至11月中 免費參觀
zh.dek: 將軍澳展覽包括多幅八九十年代未公開照片、演唱會銀色咪架及逾400名學生作品，需預先網上預約。

en.headline: Police and Immigration arrest 22 in New Territories South operation
en.dek: The joint anti-illegal worker and anti-vice action on Wednesday used small drones for high-altitude patrols and targeted blackspots across several districts.

zh.headline: 新界南跨部門打擊黑工掃黃 拘捕22人
zh.dek: 周三行動代號「冠軍」及「權能者」，使用小型無人機配合地面人員高空巡邏，突擊多個罪案黑點。

en.headline: Man dies after drowning off Kiu Tsui Chau in Sai Kung
en.dek: Police received a report at about 2.42am that someone was drowning; a passing sampan rescued the man and took him to Ho Chung Pier, where he was later pronounced dead at hospital.

zh.headline: 西貢橋咀洲附近有男子溺毙
zh.dek: 警方約凌晨2時42分接報有人遇溺，途經舡艈將男子救起送往蠣湧碼頭，其後在將軍澳醫院證實不治。

en.headline: Police seize 5.7kg of suspected cannabis from Tsuen Wan mini-storage
en.dek: Officers from the Tsuen Wan Police District Special Duties Team arrested a 28-year-old local man after finding about half a kilogramme on him and a further 5kg in a nearby storage unit.

zh.headline: 警方搞破荃灣迷你倉毒品分銷中心 檢獲約5.7公斤大麻花
zh.dek: 荃灣警區特別職務隊截查一名28歲本地男子，在其紙袋檢獲約半公斤懷疑大麻花，其後在附近迷你倉再檢獲約5公斤。

en.headline: Customs seizes 18kg of suspected scheduled dried shark fins at Lo Wu
en.dek: Officers intercepted a 68-year-old mainland woman arriving on Monday and handed the batch, valued at about HK$45,000, to the AFCD for investigation.

zh.headline: 海關羅湖截查內地婦 檢18公斤懷疑瀕危乾魚翅
zh.dek: 周一在入境大堂截獲一名68歲抵港內地女旅客行李內的乾魚翅，估計市值約4.5萬元，已交漁護署跟進。

en.headline: FEHD launches second phase of Operation Skynet targeting public markets
en.dek: The two-week operation will inspect markets for pest and hygiene issues after the first phase focused on supermarkets and restaurants.

zh.headline: 食環署展開「天網行動」第二階段 巡查全港街市
zh.dek: 為期兩周的行動針對街市害蟲及衞生問題，第一階段針對超市及食肆已結束並發出多項通知及檢控。

en.headline: Indonesian domestic helper charged with murder of 93-year-old employer
en.dek: The 52-year-old was remanded after being charged at Kwun Tong Court, following the death of the elderly woman at Tak Long Estate last Sunday.

zh.headline: 印尼外傭被控謀殺93歲僱主 還押候訊
zh.dek: 52歲女外傭周三在觀塘裁判法院被控謀殺，上日在啟德德朗邨單位被發現昏迷的93歲女僱主已證實不治。

en.headline: Police hunt man who snatched gold necklace from Tai Po jewellery store
en.dek: A man in his forties asked to try on a necklace worth nearly HK$80,000 at a Chow Sang Sang shop before fleeing on an airport-bound bus on Wednesday afternoon.

zh.headline: 警方通緝大埔珠寶店掠走金頸鏈男子
zh.dek: 一名約四十歲男子周三下午在廣福道周生生店舖要求試戴近八萬元金頸鏈後掠走，並登上往機場巴士逃走。

en.headline: Four franchised bus operators apply for fare rises of up to 17.7 per cent
en.dek: Citybus seeks the largest increase amid higher fuel costs, with the government to review applications at a Legislative Council panel on Friday.

zh.headline: 四間專營巴士營辦商申請加價 加幅8.1%至17.7%
zh.dek: 城巴申請最高17.7%，九巴16%，政府將於星期五立法會交通事務委員會討論，強調會平衡營運可持續性與市民負擔能力。

en.headline: Fire Services expands IoT fire alarm scheme to another 6000 old buildings
en.dek: More than 300 buildings have expressed interest so far, but none have completed installation yet as owners negotiate costs and consensus.

zh.headline: 消防處將物聯網火警偵測系統擴展至約6000幢7層或以上舊樓
zh.dek: 至今逾300幢樓宇提交意向書，反應理想，但暫時未有大廈完成安裝，業主需時達共識及商討工程費用。

en.headline: WestK Art Park opens LEGO Hero-ween event for children
en.dek: The free programme runs until 31 October and invites young visitors in costume to complete brick-building challenges and a final mission on Halloween night.

zh.headline: 西九藝術公園推出LEGO萬聖節英雄活動 免費入場至月底
zh.dek: 由今日至10月31日，小朋友可穿英雄裝扮參與拼砌工作坊、尋寶及萬聖節當晚壓軸任務，完成可換領限定勳章。

en.headline: Three taxi drivers disqualified under demerit points system
en.dek: The transport chief disclosed for the first time that three drivers have been banned for three months after accumulating 15 points or more since the scheme began in 2024.

zh.headline: 的士違例記分制下3名司機被取消駕駛資格3個月
zh.dek: 運輸及物流局局長陳美寶首次披露，自2024年9月制度生效以來，已有3名司機因累積15分或以上被判停牌3個月。

en.headline: Customs seizes 120000 suspected duty-not-paid cigarettes in retail crackdown
en.dek: Officers posing as customers targeted ten newsstands, grocery stores and convenience shops across the territory and arrested ten people.

zh.headline: 海關放蛇檢約12萬支懷疑未完稅香煙 拘10人
zh.dek: 海關喬裝顧客突擊全港10個報檔、士多及雜貨店，檢獲市值約54萬元香煙，拖捕3男7女。

en.headline: Fire Services joint inspection finds five fire-hazard violations
en.dek: The department, working with Buildings Department and Labour Department, checked building structures, fire safety and worksite procedures and will follow up on blocked escape routes.

zh.headline: 消防處聯同屋宇署勞工處巡查發現5項火警危險違規
zh.dek: 跨部門聯合巡查針對大廈公用地方結構、消防安全及前線施工，發現雜物阻塞逃生途徑等問題，將跟進執法。

en.headline: Marine Department opens applications for Guangdong yachts heading south
en.dek: Owners or captains of Guangdong-registered yachts can now apply up to 30 days before arrival, with the first southbound trips set for Friday.

zh.headline: 海事處即日起接受「粵艇南下」申請 最早可提前30日辦手續
zh.dek: 廣東籍遊艇船東或船長可於到港前30日辦理跨境手續，首航定於星期五。

en.headline: Lan Kwai Fong launches three-Saturday Halloween monster parade nights
en.dek: The association expects visitor numbers to rise 10 to 20 per cent from last year’s 80,000 as themed decorations, face painting and DJ sets begin this Saturday.

zh.headline: 蘭桂坊周六起一連三個周六辦萬聖節怪物巡禮夜
zh.dek: 協會料人流按年增一至兩成，去年約8萬人次，本周六起有變裝派對、面部彩繪及DJ表演。

en.headline: Kwun Tong food factory sample of meat and vegetable bun fails Bacillus cereus test
en.dek: The Centre for Food Safety found 250,000 organisms per gram in the ready-to-eat bun, well above the 100,000 unsatisfactory threshold, and ordered sales stopped.

zh.headline: 觀塘食物廠鮮肉榨菜包樣本檢出過量蠟樣芽孢桶菌
zh.dek: 食安中心指樣本每克吥25萬個菌，超出即食食品每克10萬個的不滿意標準，已飾令停售棄置及徹底清潔消毒。

en.headline: Customs seizes over 7000 suspected counterfeit items worth HK$7.6 million
en.dek: The two-week Time Shield operation targeting cross-boundary transshipment of fake watches and related goods yielded 16 cases and one arrest in Kwai Chung.

zh.headline: 海關「時盾」行動檢逾7000件懷疑冒牌貨 市值逾760萬元
zh.dek: 兩周行動打擊跨境轉運冒牌手錶等物品，偵破16宗案件，並在葵涌拘捕一名65歲男子。

en.headline: Election Committee receives 28 more nomination forms on day seven
en.dek: Returning officers took 25 candidate forms and three from designated bodies, bringing the cumulative totals to 1,086 and 35 respectively as the period runs to 20 October.

zh.headline: 選委會選舉提名期第七日再接獲28份提名表格
zh.dek: 選舉主任今日接獲25份候選人提名表格及3份指定團體提名表格，累計分別為1086份及35份，提名期至10月20日結束。

en.headline: Ta Teh Institute exhibition opens at Hong Kong Museum of History
en.dek: The free show on the short-lived Tuen Mun liberal arts college runs until 15 February and includes artefacts displayed in the city for the first time.

zh.headline: 達德學院展覽在香港歷史博物館開幕
zh.dek: 免費展覽介紹1946至1949年屯門文科大學的歷史，展期至明年2月15日，部分展品首次在港展出。

en.headline: Nearly one in three unattended dogs captured this year euthanised
en.dek: The Environment and Ecology Bureau told lawmakers the proportion has risen from 18 per cent in 2021, with 617 dogs euthanised between 2021 and May.

zh.headline: 今年捕獲的流浪狗近三分之一被人道毀滅
zh.dek: 環境及生態局回覆立法會，比例由2021年的18%大幅上升，2021年至5月共有617隻狗被人道毀滅。

en.headline: Central Kowloon Bypass to fully open on 6 December with $8 toll
en.dek: The Kowloon Bay section will open on Sunday 6 December, completing the bypass and Route 6, with a uniform $8 toll for all vehicles from the same day.

zh.headline: 中九龍繞道12月6日全線通車 收費8元
zh.dek: 九龍灣段將於12月6日通車，完成繞道及六號幹線，同日起所有車輛劃一收費8元。

en.headline: Nine hand-foot-mouth disease outbreaks recorded in first three days of week
en.dek: The Centre for Health Protection said activity has risen sharply, with nine outbreaks involving 24 people since Sunday, mostly in kindergartens and primary schools, and has written to schools.

zh.headline: 本周首三日錄得9宗手足口病爆發 涉24人
zh.dek: 衞生防護中心指活躍程度顯著上升，本周首三天已錄得九宗爆發個案涉24人，九成在幼兒中心、幼稚園或小學，已向學校發信。

en.headline: iAM Smart launches AI assistant to answer public service queries
en.dek: The Digital Policy Office said the new feature in the latest app version lets users ask questions and receive organised information drawn from official channels, with an enhanced version planned by year-end.

zh.headline: 智方便推出AI助手解答公共服務查詢
zh.dek: 數字政策辦公室表示，最新版本應用程式加入AI助手，市民輸入問題即可從官方渠道取得整理後的資訊，年底將推出加強版。

en.headline: MTR boosts East Rail and high-speed rail services for Chung Yeung weekend
en.dek: From Friday the operator will increase East Rail frequencies towards Lok Ma Chau and add extra short-haul high-speed trains, while K52A bus services to Tsang Tsui columbarium will also be strengthened.

zh.headline: 港鐵重陽節周末加強東鐵綫及高鐵短途服務
zh.dek: 由本周五起一連四天加密東鐵綫往落馬洲班次，並加開高鐵短途班次，K52A巴士亦加強往曾咀靈灰安置所服務。

en.headline: Man steals gold necklace from Tai Po jewellery store while posing as customer
en.dek: Police are hunting a man in his forties who entered a Chow Sang Sang store on Kwong Fuk Road this afternoon, asked to try on a necklace worth tens of thousands of dollars, and fled with it.

zh.headline: 大埔廣福道金行男客試戴金鏈後偷走 警正追查
zh.dek: 警方正追查一名約40歲男子，今日下午進入廣福道周生生金行伊裝顧客，試戴一條約值數萬元金鏈後奪門逃走。

en.headline: Hang Seng Index closes down 31 points at 24314
en.dek: The benchmark ended Wednesday's session at 24,314.17, a fall of 0.13 per cent from the previous close, after trading between 24,115 and 24,524.

zh.headline: 恒生指數收市報24314點 跌31點
zh.dek: 基準指數周三收報24314.17點，較前收市跌0.13%，全日高低位介乎24115至24524。

en.headline: Science Museum hosts food science exhibition on cha chaan teng classics until late October
en.dek: The '創味盤中餐' display explores the science behind pineapple buns, egg tarts and milk tea, alongside molecular gastronomy and future food trends, running until 28 October.

zh.headline: 科學館「創味盤中餐」展覽至10月底 探索茶餐廳美食科學
zh.dek: 展覽拆解菠蘿包、蛋擔、奶茶背後原理，並介紹分子料理及未來飲食，展期至10月28日。

en.headline: Complaints of nuisance behaviour on public transport hit three-year high
en.dek: The Transport Department and Environmental Protection Department recorded 66 complaints about noise and improper behaviour in 2025, more than double the 2023 figure.

zh.headline: 公共交通滋擾行為投訴三年新高
zh.dek: 運輸署及環保署2025年接獲66宗噪音及不當行為投訴，較2023年多一倍以上。

en.headline: 229 taxi drivers have incurred points under offence scheme, three disqualified
en.dek: As of early October, refusal of hire accounted for 125 of the cases under the Taxi-Driver-Offence Points system that took effect in September 2024.

zh.headline: 的士司機違例記分制已有229人被記分 三人停牌
zh.dek: 截至10月初，拒載佔記分個案125宗；制度於2024年9月生效。

en.headline: Four franchised bus operators apply for fare rises of 8.1 to 17.7 per cent
en.dek: Citybus seeks the largest increase at 17.7 per cent and Kowloon Motor Bus 16 per cent, citing high fuel costs; lawmakers will discuss the applications on Friday.

zh.headline: 四間專營巴士營辦商申請加價8.1%至17.7%
zh.dek: 城巴申請加幅最高達17.7%，九巴申請16%，指受高油價影響；立法會周五將討論有關申請。

en.headline: Government reviews dog control rules after attacks, aims to amend law next year
en.dek: Secretary for Environment and Ecology Tse Chin-wan said the review of current regulations will go to the Legislative Council by year-end, with completion of amendments targeted for next year.

zh.headline: 政府全面檢視管束狗隻法規 爭取明年內完成修例
zh.dek: 環境及生態局局長謝展寰表示，現行法規檢視將於今年年底諮詢立法會，並以明年內完成修例為目標。

en.headline: Former Hong Chi assistant house parent sentenced to 13 years for raping disabled resident
en.dek: The High Court judge described the defendant’s conduct as extremely despicable and noted the absence of any remorse when imposing the term.

zh.headline: 匡智會前助理舍監五度強姦智障女院友 判囚13年
zh.dek: 高等法院法官游德康指被告行為極可鄙、令人厭惡，並無悔意，判處監禁13年。

en.headline: Happy Valley Racecourse hosts Oktoberfest and Beerfest evenings this month
en.dek: The Hong Kong Jockey Club’s Happy Wednesday series continues tonight with live performances, Bavarian-style food and racing at the racecourse.

zh.headline: 跑馬地馬場本月三個周三舉辦Oktoberfest及Beerfest
zh.dek: 香港賽馬會Happy Wednesday系列今晚繼續，設有現場表演、巴伐利亞風格飲食及賽馬活動。

en.headline: Government requires MTR to submit Lam Tin investigation report within one month
en.dek: Transport Secretary Mable Chan said the government is very concerned about the two incidents at Lam Tin station within 15 hours and has asked the MTR Corporation for a full review and report.

zh.headline: 政府要求港鐵一個月內就藍田站事故提交調查報告
zh.dek: 運輸及物流局局長陳美寶表示，政府非常關注藍田站不足15小時內兩度發生事故，已要求港鐵深入全面調查並於一個月內提交報告。

en.headline: Government proposes HK$10 billion capital injection for San Tin Technopole Company
en.dek: The Innovation and Technology Bureau has submitted a paper to the Legislative Council outlining how the initial funding will be used to accelerate land formation and develop innovation sites.

zh.headline: 政府建議向新田科技城公司注資100億元作為起始資金
zh.dek: 創新科技及工業局向立法會提交文件，建議從資本投資基金撥出100億元予新田科技城公司，當中60億元發展創科用地、30億元加快土地平整。

en.headline: Customs seize about 7000 counterfeit items in operation against fake watches
en.dek: A 15-day special operation codenamed Time Shield targeted cross-border transshipment of counterfeit watches and netted goods worth about HK$7.6 million, with one person arrested.

zh.headline: 海關「時盾」行動檢獲約7000件冒牌貨 拘一人
zh.dek: 海關上月28日至本月13日採取特別行動打擊跨境轉運冒牌手錶，檢獲約7000件懷疑冒牌及侵權貨物，估計市值約760萬元。

en.headline: Seasonal flu programme reaches 700000 doses as Lo urges higher uptake
en.dek: Secretary for Health Lo Chung-mau said the current seasonal influenza vaccination programme has administered about 700,000 doses in less than a month and expressed hope the rate would exceed last year's figure.

zh.headline: 流感疫苗計劃至今接種70萬劑 盧寵茂冀接種率超去年
zh.dek: 醫務衞生局局長盧寵茂表示，本年度流感疫苗接種計劃自上月17日開始至今未滿一個月已接種約70萬劑，希望整體接種率可超越去年約203萬劑。

en.headline: Link's first self-built mall opens in Anderson with rooftop play park
en.dek: Ledda Plaza, a three-storey mall of nearly 140,000 square feet in the Anderson development area, began operations on 13 October with a 25,000-square-foot animal-themed rooftop playground.

zh.headline: 領展安達臣領達廣場開幕 設2.5萬呎天台樂園
zh.dek: 領展旗下安達臣新發展區全新商場領達廣場於10月13日正式開幕，樓高三層近14萬平方呎，頂層設有約2.5萬平方呎動物主題遊樂空間。

en.headline: MTR resumes Kwun Tong Line after platform equipment smoke at Lam Tin
en.dek: Smoke from platform equipment at Lam Tin station this morning caused trains to skip the stop and the station to close temporarily; services have since returned to normal.

zh.headline: 藍田站月台設備冒煙已處理 觀塘綫服務逐步復常
zh.dek: 周三早上藍田站月台有設備冒煙，觀塘綫列車一度不停該站，車站暫時關閉；港鐵指情況已處理好，服務陸續恢復正常。

en.headline: Woman dies after being found in the sea off Sheung Wan
en.dek: Firefighters rescued a woman in her 50s or 60s from the water near the Rumsey Street car park early on Wednesday; she was unconscious and later died in hospital.

zh.headline: 上環女子墮海獲救不治 警方調查
zh.dek: 周三凌晨約2時，上環林士街停車場對開海面有女子載浮載沉，消防救起後昏迷送院，最終不治。

en.headline: HKUMed to host first World Health Summit Regional Meeting in Hong Kong
en.dek: The faculty will organise the meeting from 7 to 9 May 2027 at the Convention and Exhibition Centre under the theme Health Across Borders, expecting about 2,000 participants.

zh.headline: 港大醫學院將主辦世界衛生峰會2027年區域會議
zh.dek: 會議將於明年5月7日至9日在會展中心舉行，主題為「健康無界」，預計吸引約2000人參與，是香港首次主辦。

en.headline: Airside opens Kuromi Starlit Sweet Party with six-metre installation
en.dek: The Kai Tak mall launches a dessert-themed Sanrio event from today until 8 November, featuring a tall Kuromi macaron sculpture, photo spots and a limited pop-up store.

zh.headline: 啟德Airside推出Kuromi魔幻烘焙所 設6米高裝置
zh.dek: 商場由今日起至11月8日在二樓中庭舉行Sanrio主題活動，設有巨型Kuromi馬卡龍裝置、打卡位及期間限定店。

en.headline: Car collides with road works vehicle on Gascoigne Road in Yau Ma Tei
en.dek: A white private car struck the rear of a road works vehicle early on Wednesday morning; the driver sustained abrasions and was treated at the scene.

zh.headline: 油麻地加士居道私家車撞工程車 司機擦傷現場治理
zh.dek: 周三凌晨約5時，一輚白色私家車撞向工程車車尾，司機受擦傷並在現場接受治療，警方正調查成因。

en.headline: Housing Authority begins HOS 2025 flat selection on 21 October
en.dek: Nearly 7,000 new flats across five projects in Kai Tak, Kam Tin, Tseung Kwan O, Ping Shan and Tung Chung will be offered at 70 per cent of assessed market value.

zh.headline: 房委會居屋2025下周三開始選樓 推近7000個單位
zh.dek: 五個新項目位於啟德、錦田、將軍澳、屏山及東涌，以評定市值七折發售，售價約150萬至480萬元。

en.headline: Police charge 52-year-old domestic helper with murder over Kai Tak death
en.dek: The Indonesian helper who had been caring for a 93-year-old woman at Tak Long Estate faces a holding charge of murder and is due to appear in Kwun Tong Magistrates’ Courts on Wednesday.

zh.headline: 警方暫控52歲外傭謀殺 啟德德朗邨九旬婦死亡案
zh.dek: 照顧德朗邨93歲女子的印尼外傭被暫控一項謀殺罪，案件周三上午在觀塘裁判法院提堂。

en.headline: Lan Kwai Fong launches Halloween Monster Mash events through end of October
en.dek: The district’s annual celebrations begin on 14 October with themed food, evening DJ sets and a short monster street performance on selected nights.

zh.headline: 蘭桂坊萬聖節怪物巡禮夜由今日起至月底舉行
zh.dek: 區內餐廳推出主題餐飲，指定晚上有DJ打碟及怪物軍團於晚上8時至8時半快閃街道表演。

en.headline: Police arrest five over rental scam targeting mainland students and talent
en.dek: A group operating for about two months allegedly used fake listings and forged tenancy agreements to take roughly HK$1.04 million from nine victims; three remain in custody.

zh.headline: 警方搗破專騙港漂生及高才通人士租屋集團 拘5人涉約104萬元
zh.dek: 集團運作約兩個月，透過內地社交平台假租盤及偽造租約，涉9宗案件騙款約104萬元；5人被捕，3人仍被扣查。

en.headline: Two women arrested after fight near Tsim Sha Tsui Clock Tower
en.dek: Police received a report at about 6.57pm of a confrontation on Salisbury Road; both women were arrested for fighting in a public place and taken to hospital with injuries.

zh.headline: 尖沙咀鐘樓附近兩女打架被捕 送院治理
zh.dek: 警方晚上約6時57分接報梳士巴利道有女子被拳打；兩名女子涉嫌在公眾地方打鬥被捕，分別報稱頭部及背部受傷並送往廣華醫院。

en.headline: Police investigate death of 13-year-old girl found hanging in Yau Ma Tei flat
en.dek: A mother reported finding her daughter hanging in a room at a Nathan Road building on Tuesday evening; the girl was confirmed dead at the scene and a note was recovered.

zh.headline: 油麻地13歲女童寓所內上吊死亡 警方調查
zh.dek: 周二晚上約9時44分，母親報稱在彌敦道旺角大樓單位房間發現女兒上吊並將她解下；女童當場證實死亡，現場檢獲遺書。

en.headline: Five vehicles collide near Cheung Tsing Tunnel exit, three injured
en.dek: Police received a report at about 6.44pm of a multi-vehicle crash involving a light goods vehicle and private cars on the Kowloon-bound side; three people with minor injuries were taken to hospital and some lanes were…

zh.headline: 長青隧道出口附近5車相撞 3人輕傷
zh.dek: 警方晚上約6時44分接報青葵公路往九龍方向長青隧道出口附近多車相撞，涉及輕型貨車及私家車；3名傷者清醒輕傷，部分行車線一度封閉。

en.headline: Customs seize about 320000 suspected pharmaceutical products at bridge port
en.dek: An outbound goods vehicle at the Hong Kong-Zhuhai-Macao Bridge Hong Kong Port was found carrying roughly 320,000 suspected pharmaceutical products valued at about HK$18 million; the Mainland driver faces a court…

zh.headline: 海關港珠澳大橋口岸檢獲約32萬件懷疑藥劑製品 市值約1800萬元
zh.dek: 人員根據風險評估截查一輛出境貨車，在貨斗發現約32萬件懷疑藥劑製品，估計市值約1800萬元；39歲內地男司機被控企圖輸出未列艙單貨物，明日提堂。

en.headline: Centre for Health Protection investigates new mpox case, suggests temporary venue closure
en.dek: A 39-year-old man who developed a rash and tested positive for mpox is in stable condition in isolation; the centre recommended temporary closure of a Mong Kok premises he visited during the incubation period.

zh.headline: 衞生防護中心調查新增猴痘個案 建議旺角處所暫時關閉
zh.dek: 一名39歲男子出現紅疹並確診猴痘，情況穩定正接受隔離治療；中心建議他潛伏期曾多次到訪的旺角處所即日起暫時關閉。

en.headline: Customs seize 8000kg unmanifested tobacco at Shenzhen Bay
en.dek: Officers stopped a medium goods vehicle claiming to carry plastic wood flooring and found about 300 boxes of duty-unpaid manufactured tobacco with an estimated market value of HK$53.4 million.

zh.headline: 海關深圳灣檢獲約8000公斤未完稅煙草 拘司機
zh.dek: 人員截查報稱載有塑木地板的中型貨車，發現約300箱未列艙單及未完稅製成煙草，估計市值約5340萬元，51歲本地男司機被捕。

en.headline: MTR resumes Kwun Tong Line after trackside fire at Lam Tin
en.dek: A fire beside the tracks at Lam Tin station halted services between Kwun Tong and Tiu Keng Leng during the evening peak; the blaze has been extinguished and trains are returning to normal.

zh.headline: 藍田站路軌旁火警擔滅 觀塘綫服務逐步復常
zh.dek: 觀塘綫藍田站路軌旁傍晚發生火警，觀塘至調景嶺一度暫停，消防及港鐵人員已擔滅火種，列車服務於下午6時36分起逐步回復正常。

en.headline: Ocean Park announces conservation facilities ahead of 50th anniversary
en.dek: The park will open a marine mammal conservation centre next January displaying a Bryde's whale skeleton and a new panda pavilion in the third quarter of next year as it marks 50 years in 2027.

zh.headline: 海洋公園公布50周年保育設施 明年展出布氏鯨骨骼
zh.dek: 園區明年1月10日迎來50周年，將開設海洋哺乳動物保育中心展出西貢擱淺布氏鯨骨骼標本，並於明年第三季啟用全新大熊貓展館。

en.headline: Police arrest 44 in operation against triad phone scam and money laundering
en.dek: A two-day Organised Crime and Triad Bureau action codenamed Thunder 2026 targeted a Wo Shing Wo-controlled fake customer-service call centre, a hotel-based laundering operation and illegal gambling dens, involving at…

zh.headline: 警方雷霆2026行動拘44人 搞三合會電騙及洗黑錢中心
zh.dek: 有組織罪案及三合會調查科一連兩日行動，瓦解和勝和控制的假冒客服電話詐騙中心、西九龍酒店洗黑錢中心及非法賭檔，最少涉65宗案件。

en.headline: CLP voltage dip traps people in lifts across Kowloon and New Territories
en.dek: A momentary sag on a 400-kilovolt line from Lai Chi Kok to Tsz Wan Shan at about 1.09pm prompted nearly 180 lift entrapment reports and dozens of false fire alarms; rescues are complete.

zh.headline: 中電40萬伏特線路電壓驟降 九龍新界近180宗困升降機
zh.dek: 荔枝角至慈雲山供電線路下午約1時09分錄得短暫電壓驟降，電力無中斷；消防接獲近180宗困升降機及約40宗火警鐘誤鳴，救援已完成。

en.headline: Government renews free TV licences of three broadcasters for 12 years
en.dek: The Chief Executive in Council approved renewals for HK Television Entertainment, TVB and i-CABLE HOY, with combined investment commitments of about HK$9.48 billion in the first six years and updated programme rules.

zh.headline: 三間免費電視台牌照獲續期12年 首六年承諾投資近95億元
zh.dek: 行政長官會同行政會議批准香港電視娛樂、無綫及有線寬頻開電視續牌12年，並落實放寬措施及加強國民教育等節目要求。

en.headline: Hang Seng Index closes up 74 points at 24345
en.dek: The benchmark recovered from an early slide to finish higher on Tuesday, with financial and property stocks among the gainers while technology shares remained mixed.

zh.headline: 恒生指數收升74點報24345點
zh.dek: 恒指周二早段下跌後午後回升，金融及地產股向上，科技股則表現參差。

en.headline: Education Bureau updates guide to discourage grade retention for SEN students
en.dek: The revised School Administration Guide says schools should avoid repeating grades for students with special educational needs, citing risks to social and emotional adaptation and mental health.

zh.headline: 教育局更新學校行政手冊 提醒學校避免安排特殊教育需要學生留級
zh.dek: 修訂後的手冊指學校應盡量避免讓學生留級，尤其不應安排有特殊教育需要的學生留級，以免加劇社交情緒適應困難及增加精神健康風險。

en.headline: Law Society opens arbitration and mediation centre at former Central office
en.dek: The 30,000-square-foot facility at Wing On House includes three arbitration suites and meeting rooms, with the society planning to offer space to members at half market rates.

zh.headline: 律師會中環舊會址改建為仲裁調解中心 周二正式開幕
zh.dek: 永安集團大廈三萬平方呎設施設有三個仲裁套房及多個會議室，律師會計劃以市價一半租金租予會員使用。

en.headline: Police arrest 20 in crackdown on transnational prostitution syndicate
en.dek: Officers detained a group including a Thai ringleader after an operation targeting premises in Sham Shui Po and Tsuen Wan, freezing more than HK$10 million in suspected proceeds.

zh.headline: 警方搗破深水埗跨國賣淫集團 拘捕20人並凍結逾千萬元犯罪得益
zh.dek: 行動針對深水埗及荃灣的有組織集團，拘捕包括泰籍主腦在內的20人，指集團要求女子提供30至45次無償性服務以抵償來港費用。

en.headline: Police upgrade Anita Mui ashes case to New Territories South regional unit
en.dek: The investigation into the missing urn of the late Cantopop singer, reported three months ago at Po Lin Monastery, has been transferred from the Lantau district squad.

zh.headline: 警方將梅艷芳骨灰失蹤案升級由新界南總區重案組跟進
zh.dek: 已故歌手骨灰於7月在大嶼山寶蓮禪寺失蹤的個案，原由離島區重案組處理，現轉交更高層級單位，暫未有人被捕。

en.headline: Civil Service Bureau offers priority hiring for affected Hongkong Post staff
en.dek: The Federation of Trade Unions said the arrangements include preferential selection for transfers and relaxed education requirements for clerical grades.

zh.headline: 公務員事務局為受影響香港郵政員工轉職提供優先聘用
zh.dek: 工聯會引述安排，受影響員工轉任其他職系可獲優先選拔，轉任助理文書主任等職系可放寬學歷要求。

en.headline: Huanggang Port records 79500 passenger trips on first day of operations
en.dek: Transport Secretary Mable Chan said immigration clearance and public transport connections ran smoothly, meeting official expectations ahead of the holiday weekend.

zh.headline: 新皇崗口岸首日錄得7.95萬人次及8000車輛架次出入境
zh.dek: 運輸及物流局局長陳美寶表示，出入境及公共交通接駁整體順暢，符合預期，當局正為重陽節長周末增加人手及服務作準備。

en.headline: SFC orders ChaPanda operator to suspend trading from Tuesday morning
en.dek: The regulator directed the Stock Exchange to halt dealings in Sichuan Baicha Baidao Industrial under rules covering potentially false or misleading documents.

zh.headline: 證監會指令茶百道營運商周二早上起停牌
zh.dek: 監管機構指示聯交所根據涉及文件可能載有虛假或誤導資料的規則，暫停四川百茶百道實業股份買賣。

en.headline: Animals Asia therapy dog programme booked out until February 2027
en.dek: The Dr Dog and Professor Paws visits, run by one staff member and 65 volunteers, are finalists in the teamwork category of the Spirit of Hong Kong Awards.

zh.headline: 亞洲動物基金治療犬計劃預約至2027年2月已滿
zh.dek: 由一名職員及65名義工組成的Dr Dog及Professor Paws探訪計劃，獲提名競逐香港精神獎團隊合作組別。

en.headline: Marine Department coordinates with Guangdong ahead of Friday yacht first voyage
en.dek: Secretary for Transport and Logistics Mable Chan said preparations include captain training, real-time monitoring and an electronic service system for the southbound Guangdong yachts.

zh.headline: 粵艇南下周五行首航 海事處與廣東密切溝通做好準備
zh.dek: 運輸及物流局局長陳美寶表示，當局已進行船長培訓考核、建立實時監察系統及電子業務系統，並會加強安全提示及巡邏。

en.headline: Two men arrested after fight over money in Ma On Shan car park
en.dek: A 42-year-old and a 36-year-old were detained early Tuesday after a dispute in a car park on Kam Ying Road; both were taken to hospital with minor injuries.

zh.headline: 馬鞍山停車場兩男因錢財問題互毆 涉公眾地方打鬥被捕
zh.dek: 今早約3時40分，錦英路6號停車場兩名男子因金錢問題爭執互毆，分別頭部及頸部受傷送院，警方以涉嫌公眾地方打鬥拘捕。

en.headline: Man injured after charger overheats in Tsz Ching Estate flat fire
en.dek: About 250 residents were evacuated from Ching On House in Tsz Wan Shan after a fire early Tuesday; a 70-year-old man was taken to hospital.

zh.headline: 慈正邨正安樓單位充電器過熱起火 七旬男戶主受傷 約250人疏散
zh.dek: 慈雲山慈正邨正安樓24樓單位今早約6時起火，初步相信外置充電器過熱引起，七旬男戶主燒傷送院，約250名居民疏散。
